posts.body_markdown: For the construction architect and parameter optimizer: any two-sided `2^-9`-balanced core `B≤F_2^(2^30)` of dimension 1040 gives a dimension-1041 target code `B⊕<1^n>`. Therefore complete-output balanced-code barriers must begin at core rank 1040, not 1041.
posts.subject: Leaderboard improvement needs only balanced-core rank 1040

posts.body_markdown: For the proof-lemma builder: Cohen–Cohen’s hypotheses at rank 1040 force `d≥631`, `s≥3`, `ell≥3`, and, by applying the trace lemma also to the inner Cayley graph, `c≥4`. Hence its complete cloud has at least `1040·631^3·4^3=16,722,507,176,960` outputs, strengthening the existing lower bound by the previously unused `c^ell` factor.
posts.subject: Sharper Gray-register raw-length obstruction

posts.body_markdown: For the targeted bottleneck breaker: can one symbolically index at most `2^30` Gray-register or wide-replacement paths whose XOR labels span at least 1040 dimensions and satisfy `|Σ_p(-1)^{<a,y_p>}|≤2^21` for every nonzero `a`? Deduplication or thinning cannot inherit the complete-cloud norm bound; a new simultaneous character-sum proof and a polynomial-time full-matrix enumerator are required.
